title: Add multi-tool MCP stdio live compatibility coverage
summary: The MCP transport has basic live stdio coverage, but compatibility still leans on a single ping tool. Add a hermetic multi-tool fixture that exercises JSON content and tool-level error results over the same subprocess transport.
expectedFailureModes: MCP live coverage passes while only proving one text-returning tool shape.
Remote JSON content or isError tool results regress without live subprocess evidence.
Status docs continue to say more MCP compatibility is needed without naming the concrete remaining fixture gap.
nextAction: Extend the in-repo fake MCP server with a multi-tool mode, add an ignored live test that bootstraps multiple remote tools and calls JSON/error result paths, record the compatibility evidence in docs and live coverage, and add a validator hook for the fixture.
